headline: X Money is launching in the US starting today
summary: X Money, part of Elon Musk's "everything app" vision, rolls out in the US today. It offers a digital wallet, peer-to-peer payments, and a metal Visa card. Apple Wallet support and other perks are included.

headline: Razer’s analog Huntsman V3 Pro is over 20 percent off
summary: Razer's Huntsman V3 Pro TKL gaming keyboard, featuring adjustable optical switches, is now over 20% off. This compact, wired keyboard offers customizable and faster response times. The deal is a notable offer for gamers seeking advanced keyboard technology.

headline: Xbox’s huge outage even blocked games on disc
summary: An extensive Xbox outage blocked users from playing both digital and disc-based games. The outage, which started Sunday evening, also prevented logins and app launches. Xbox's status page confirmed the widespread service issues.

headline: Nanoleaf’s colorful pegboard and shelf kit is half off
summary: Nanoleaf's Blocks Combo XL Smarter Kit, combining smart lighting and storage, is now 50% off. This fun back-to-school buy offers customizable light and wall storage. The kit is available for a new low price of $99.99.

headline: Xbox Executive Explains Outage, Vows to 'Do Better'
summary: Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet explained the recent system outage affecting game libraries and sign-ins. He offered transparency regarding the issues from Sunday night into Monday. Van Vliet assured users that Xbox is committed to improving its services.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Is Projected to Have the Biggest Opening of 2026
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is forecast to achieve the largest box office opening of 2026. The film is expected to be a massive commercial success. Projections indicate it will significantly outperform other releases.

headline: Avengers: Secret Wars Is the Only MCU Movie in 2027 as Kevin Feige Promises Quality Over Quantity
summary: Avengers: Secret Wars will be the sole MCU movie released in 2027. Kevin Feige confirmed Marvel Studios is prioritizing quality over quantity. This strategic shift aims to enhance the cinematic experience for fans.

headline: Call of Duty: Black Ops Fans Discover Cut Zombies Content Over 15 Years After Release
summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops fans have uncovered previously unreleased Zombies mode content. The discovery comes over 15 years after the game's initial launch. This hidden content offers new insights for dedicated players.

headline: Wildfire now nine miles from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
summary: A wildfire is now nine miles from Bordeaux, prompting warnings from the city's mayor. Authorities are preparing for potential further evacuations. A nearby mayor described the situation as "catastrophic."

headline: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
summary: Wildfires near Bordeaux have consumed over 162 square miles in less than four days. The Madrid region is experiencing its worst fires ever recorded. Maps show the scale of the devastation and ongoing containment efforts across Europe.

headline: Reform UK reports Zack Polanski to police over guillotine T-shirt post
summary: Reform UK has reported Zack Polanski to the police. The report concerns a social media post featuring a guillotine T-shirt. The shirt depicted the name "Nigel" alongside the image.

headline: New technical education routes to be offered at 14 in England
summary: England will introduce new technical education pathways for 14-year-olds. The government aims to link these subjects, like AI and manufacturing, to local job markets. This initiative seeks to better prepare students for future careers.
